exposure: New York Heart Association class >= II
outcome: positive PPMAD screen (PHQ-9 or GAD-7 score >=10)
cohort: This study included patients who delivered between June 2019 and February 2024 at a tertiary care institution, comparing a cardiac cohort with a non-cardiac cohort matched on demographic factors.
finding: Cardiac disease alone was not independently associated with positive PPMAD screening, but poorly optimized cardiac status, social history, and adverse pregnancy outcomes were associated with an increased risk of PPMAD.
